intelligence.human_view: This run is one lesson told four ways: the delivery, the link, the home, and the look. The delivery closes the seam in the Continuous Cycle Law — check and deliver in the same breath, at the moment of return, because the night of 2026-11-13 proved eight hours of finished work sitting unshown is eight hours of nothing. The link proves "bytes verified" is not "he sees the update": the file was right and the tap was wrong, and his question was the right one — how can you send "it's updated" with an old link? The ledger and the timestamp answer it: one CURRENT link per item, the old one marked superseded, the exact URL fetched before it is sent. The main URL law ends the scattering — 48 practice URLs inventoried in one list so he can point at the newest, and from here done lives where he looks. And the look ends the guessing: his pictures are the ruling, dark middle and white icon, and the white middle he overturned at 21:57Z is closed by his own pictures at 21:59Z, two minutes later. The army carries all of it, because a Naya who has not read the training has not started.
intelligence.simple_view: When your friend finishes something, look at it right away. Then show it right away. Finished work should live in one place, so everyone can find it. The buttons should look like the pictures: dark in the middle, with a bright white picture on top. The words should be big and clear. A number should always be true.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, when work comes back, check it right away and pass it along right away — don't let it sit on the shelf. Send the right link, with a fresh date on it, so he sees the new page and not the old one. Finished work lives on the main page, always there, like auto-save. And the buttons look like his pictures now — dark in the middle, white picture, glowing edges, real buttons. The words are big and clear, and every number tells the truth.
intelligence.naya_view: CHECK IT RIGHT AWAY, DELIVER IT RIGHT AWAY, LIVE ON THE MAIN URL. TIMESTAMP EVERY LINK, KEEP ONE CURRENT LINK PER ITEM IN THE LEDGER, VERIFY THE EXACT LINK HE WILL TAP. DONE MEANS LIVE ON THE MAIN URL, LIKE AUTO-SAVE. THE LOOK IS THE PICTURES — DARK MIDDLE, WHITE ICON, ELEVATED, GLOWING, LIT UP, ROUNDED, REAL BUTTONS. THE WHITE MIDDLE IS OUT. TEXT IS 25/19/17, LAYERED, MULTIPLE COLORS, EASY TO READ. A COUNT MUST BE TRUE. CONTACTS ARE SMART LINKS ON SMART TABS, AUTO-ORGANIZED BY DEFAULT. TRAIN THE ARMY — A NAYA WHO HAS NOT READ THE TRAINING HAS NOT STARTED.
